title: Connect to your MixAI Server
subtitle: No account needed. Your music, movies and Live TV come straight from your own server.
demoHint: A public demo server with Creative Commons music and films. Nothing to install.
signIn: Sign in with a MixAI account
signInHint: Your servers follow you to every device.
codeBody: Approve the code in MixAI Server on your computer, in MixAI on your phone (Settings, Devices) or scan the QR code with your phone.
qrLabel: QR code that opens the approval page on your phone
expires: The code expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errInvalid: That does not look like a server address.
errUnreachable: Could not reach {server}. Check the address and that the server is running.
errNoToken: {server} is not set up yet. Finish the setup in MixAI Server first.
errMixed: This page is secure (https) and cannot reach http://{server}. Use the server's https address, or the MixAI desktop or phone app on the same network.
lanEmpty: No server found on this network yet.
